name: codecrosscheck
description: Two-model review loop: a worker LLM produces, a reviewer LLM judges, both as a Node CLI and a VS Code chat participant.

scripts.verify: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test

author: Timo Piironen

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeCrossCheck runs configured build and test commands, executes model-authored code in the EXECUTE sandbox, and writes model-proposed edits into the workspace. All three require trust in the workspace contents.

chatParticipants.name: codecrosscheck
chatParticipants.description: Two-model review loop for plans, code, and execution.

commands.name: review-branch
commands.description: Review the current branch diff (vs origin/main merge-base)

commands.name: apply-review
commands.description: Apply the latest /review-branch fix proposal to the working tree

commands.name: openspec-new
commands.description: Create a new OpenSpec change directory

commands.name: openspec-review
commands.description: Draft an implementation for an OpenSpec change (validator-gated). Chain with /apply-review to write the drafted edits.

commands.title: CodeCrossCheck: Pick Worker and Reviewer Models

codecrosscheck.workerModel.description: Model family used by the worker (the producing LLM), e.g. 'anthropic/claude-opus-5'. Only used as a fallback when codecrosscheck.useChatPickerWorker is false or the Copilot Chat picker supplies no model. Run 'CodeCrossCheck: Pick Worker and Reviewer Models' to choose from the families this VS Code session can actually reach.

codecrosscheck.reviewerModel.description: Model family used by the reviewer (the judging LLM). Should differ from the worker for cross-vendor review.

codecrosscheck.workerModelOverride.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: codecrosscheck.workerModel is now free text. Set it directly. This setting is still honoured and still takes precedence.
codecrosscheck.workerModelOverride.description: Deprecated. Free-text model family override for the worker.

codecrosscheck.reviewerModelOverride.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: codecrosscheck.reviewerModel is now free text. Set it directly. This setting is still honoured and still takes precedence.
codecrosscheck.reviewerModelOverride.description: Deprecated. Free-text model family override for the reviewer.

codecrosscheck.useChatPickerWorker.description: When true, the chat participant uses the model picked in the Copilot Chat model picker as the worker, falling back to codecrosscheck.workerModel if no model is provided. The reviewer always uses codecrosscheck.reviewerModel.

codecrosscheck.maxIters.description: Maximum loop iterations per stage before returning the last artifact unapproved.

codecrosscheck.reviewBranch.maxDiffChars.description: Hard char-budget cap for /review-branch, counting the branch diff plus any files attached to the request. If the assembled prompt exceeds this many characters, the command aborts with guidance to pass a closer diff-base or split the branch, instead of letting the reviewer LM return 'Message exceeds token limit'. Set to 0 to disable the guard.

codecrosscheck.reviewBranch.keepTranscri.description: How many run transcripts to retain in .codecrosscheck/runs. Older transcripts are deleted on each run. Transcripts contain full source diffs, so this bounds both disk use and how much source history is left lying in the workspace.

codecrosscheck.execute.timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout (milliseconds) for sandboxed code execution. Note: the sandbox isolates only the working directory and environment — generated code runs with your filesystem privileges and unrestricted network access.

codecrosscheck.applyReview.testCommand.description: Optional shell command run in a dedicated VS Code terminal after /apply-review writes edits (e.g. 'npm test'). Empty disables the test step. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot set this, and it runs only in a trusted workspace.

codecrosscheck.applyReview.buildCommand.description: Optional shell command run synchronously after /apply-review writes edits (e.g. 'dotnet build -nologo' or 'npm run build'). Unlike testCommand, the result is captured: exit code and tail of output are surfaced in chat, and a non-zero exit code is reported as a build-gate failure so /review-branch can be re-run with the build error as input. Empty disables the gate. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot set this, and it runs only in a trusted workspace.

codecrosscheck.applyReview.buildTimeoutM.description: Hard timeout (milliseconds) for codecrosscheck.applyReview.buildCommand. Default 5 minutes.

codecrosscheck.applyReview.dryRun.description: When true, /apply-review prints planned edits without writing to disk.

codecrosscheck.tools.maxCalls.description: Maximum workspace tool calls (read_file, search_workspace, list_directory) one agent may make per turn. When the budget runs out the agent is told so and must answer from what it already has. Set to 0 to disable tool access.

codecrosscheck.tools.deadlineMs.description: Wall-clock limit (milliseconds) on one agent's tool-gathering phase, so a model that keeps asking for files cannot stall a run.
